# Test fixtures

**All fixtures here are synthetic.** The P1 build environment had no route to SEC EDGAR, Alpaca or
Alpha Vantage, so these files reproduce the documented response shapes with invented companies
(CIK 900001–900005, tickers `ALFA` … `ECHO`). They are *not* real market data.

- `edgar/`, `alpaca/`, `news/` — small hand-written payloads for parser tests.
- `http/` — the replay tree for the backfill smoke (`make gate-P1`), generated by
  `uv run python -m tests.fixtures.synth`. Paths follow `ingest.http.fixture_path`.
- `universe_smoke.yaml` — universe rules for the synthetic sectors.

To replace them with real recordings (network + keys required):

```
uv run python -m ingest.backfill --days 90 --tickers AAPL,MSFT,... --end 2024-06-28 \
    --record tests/fixtures/http --universe config/universe.yaml
```

Before choosing `NEWS_PROVIDER` (§18.1), inspect real news recordings with
`ingest.news.timestamp_audit`.
